verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online offers bank feed matching, reconciliation reports, discrepancy/missing-checks reports, and an 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that can 'help resolve anomalies,' plus an MCP server exposing 145 API tools that could be wired into an agent — but there's no evidence of an end-to-end autonomous agent that reconciles a full month, flags exceptions, and prepares a close package for human review as a single capability.
